arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom import glom, T, Spec

# Test dynamic key evaluation - keys should be evaluated as specs
target = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
result = glom(target, {T['a']: T['b']})  # Key T['a'] should evaluate to 1
print('Dynamic key result:', result)
assert result == {1: 2}, f'Expected {{1: 2}}, got {result}'

# Test that literal keys still work
result2 = glom({'x': 1}, {'key': 'val'})  
print('Literal key result:', result2)
assert result2 == {'key': 'val'}, f'Expected {{\"key\": \"val\"}}, got {result2}'

print('All tests passed!')
"
